name: Tonic
description: Restores 25 Vigor.

name: Strong Tonic
description: Restores 70 Vigor.

name: Remedy
description: Cures any status.

name: Spark Drop
description: Restores 5 Energy to the active Spirling.

name: Waking Moss
description: Wakes a fainted Spirling outside battle with a third of its Vigor.

name: Kin Charm
description: Hold it out during a bond to steady the link (+10%).

name: Grapple Line
description: Wayfarer Gear. Face a far post across narrow water and press A to pull yourself over.
hint: The far side is just out of reach. A grapple line could bridge it.

name: Climbing Pick
description: Wayfarer Gear. Face a low cliff and press A to climb up or down it.
hint: A steep rock face. With a climbing pick you could get a grip.

name: Storm Lantern
description: Wayfarer Gear. Lights pitch-dark places so you can walk through them.
hint: It's pitch dark ahead. A lantern would help.

name: Spark Coil
description: Keepsake. The holder gains 1 extra Energy every turn.

name: Bark Wrap
description: Keepsake. The holder recovers a little Vigor at the end of each turn.

name: Iron Burr
description: Keepsake. Physical hits on the holder deal 15% less damage.

name: Wind Anklet
description: Keepsake. Raises the holder's Pace by 15%.

name: Whetstone
description: Keepsake. A sharpened edge: the holder lands keen hits twice as often.

name: Spring Flask
description: A flask of rest-spring water. Restores all Vigor.

name: Cooling Gel
description: Cures Scorch.

name: Dry Towel
description: Cures Soak.

name: Wake Bell
description: Cures Drowse.

name: Power Brew
description: Raises the active Spirling's Might in battle.

name: Guard Brew
description: Raises the active Spirling's Guard in battle.

name: Focus Brew
description: Raises the active Spirling's FOC in battle.

name: Dash Brew
description: Raises the active Spirling's Pace in battle.

name: Tide Shell
description: A pearl that hums with the sea. Some Spirlings change when they hold it close.

name: Spark Charm
description: Brightens one Spark value of a Spirling (+3).

name: Echo Crystal: Kiln Strike
description: Teaches Kiln Strike to an Ember Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Spindrift Shot
description: Teaches Spindrift Shot to a Tide Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Sap Draw
description: Teaches Sap Draw to a Bloom Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Storm Gnash
description: Teaches Storm Gnash to a Volt Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Tremor Thud
description: Teaches Tremor Thud to a Stone Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Gale Scythe
description: Teaches Gale Scythe to a Gale Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Prism Ray
description: Teaches Prism Ray to a Lumen Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Gloom Ripple
description: Teaches Gloom Ripple to an Umbra Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Furnace Heart
description: Teaches Furnace Heart to an Ember Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Fathom Crush
description: Teaches Fathom Crush to a Tide Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Tailwind
description: Teaches Tailwind to a Gale Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Root Grip
description: Teaches Root Grip to a Bloom Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Night Veil
description: Teaches Night Veil to an Umbra Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Squall
description: Teaches Squall to a Gale Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Dawn Mend
description: Teaches Dawn Mend to a Lumen Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Radiant Lance
description: Teaches Radiant Lance to a Lumen Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Scatter Gale
description: Teaches Scatter Gale to any Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Graft
description: Teaches Graft to any Spirling. Never used up.

name: Wading Boots
description: Wayfarer Gear. Tall leather boots: walk through shallow water, step by step.
hint: The water here is shallow, but too cold for bare feet. Wading boots would do.

name: Survey Glass
description: Wayfarer Gear. A brass spyglass: face open ground and press A to spot hidden finds up to 6 steps ahead on the minimap. It needs 20 seconds between looks.
hint: With a Survey Glass you could look for hidden finds from here.

name: Tide Chart
description: Wayfarer Gear. A tidewatcher's chart: open it in the satchel to see when the next low and high tide come, by the clock of your device.

name: Rubbing Charcoal
description: Wayfarer Gear. A stick of charcoal and a roll of thin paper: face a weathered stone and press A to take a rubbing and read its worn inscription.

name: Pry Bar
description: Wayfarer Gear. Face a sluice wheel, a mine cart or a grate and press A to turn, shove or lift it.
hint: It won't budge by hand. A pry bar would give you the leverage.

name: Rope Ladder
description: Wayfarer Gear. Face a marked edge over a shaft and press A to tie it on. It stays there, and you climb down rung by rung.
hint: A chalk mark on the edge of a shaft. A rope ladder could be tied on here.

name: Plank Bundle
description: Wayfarer Gear. Face a gap with a chalk mark and press A to lay a plank over it. The plank stays.
hint: A narrow gap with a chalk mark. A plank would bridge it.

name: Riftheart
description: Held memento: +15% Might. Permanent, 1 piece.

name: Glass Shield
description: Held memento: +15% Guard. Permanent, 1 piece.

name: Clear Shard
description: Held memento: +15% Focus. Permanent, 1 piece.

name: Whirl Glass
description: Held memento: +15% Speed and +5% Focus. Permanent, 1 piece.

name: Core Glass
description: Held memento: +12% Vigor. Permanent, 1 piece.

name: Ember Prism
description: Held memento: +20% damage for Ember techniques. Permanent.

name: Tide Prism
description: Held memento: +20% damage for Tide techniques. Permanent.

name: Bloom Prism
description: Held memento: +20% damage for Bloom techniques. Permanent.

name: Volt Prism
description: Held memento: +20% damage for Volt techniques. Permanent.

name: Stone Prism
description: Held memento: +20% damage for Stone techniques. Permanent.

name: Gale Prism
description: Held memento: +20% damage for Gale techniques. Permanent.

name: Lumen Prism
description: Held memento: +20% damage for Lumen techniques. Permanent.

name: Umbra Prism
description: Held memento: +20% damage for Umbra techniques. Permanent.

name: Echo Ring
description: Held memento: heals 1/10 of Vigor every round.

name: Hold Stone
description: Held memento: once per battle, a hit that would knock the holder out from full Vigor leaves it with 1 Vigor. Permanent.

name: Echo Scent
description: Bonding gets clearly easier for one try.

name: Bond Seal
description: The next bond with a wild Spirling succeeds for sure, also with ancient and one-of-a-kind ones. Rift Wardens and other Wayfarers' Spirlings can never be bonded.

name: Spark Shard
description: Raises one chosen value by 6 Sparks, up to 12.

name: Ring Tonic
description: A Spirling gains 1 Ring at once. Never above the Ring cap.

name: Great Ring Tonic
description: A Spirling gains 5 Rings at once. Never above the Ring cap.

name: Ring Elixir
description: A Spirling rises to the current Ring cap.

name: Growth Crystal
description: Double growth for the whole team for the next 20 battles.

name: Great Growth Crystal
description: Triple growth for the whole team for the next 20 battles.

name: Coin Gleam
description: Double coins from battles for 20 battles.

name: Encounter Call
description: Twice as many wild encounters for the next 30 steps.

name: Battle Skip
description: Offered before a wild battle against one foe at least 10 Rings below your lead: your team wins it at once, with full growth. Used up.

name: Rematch Key
description: Talk to a beaten Wayfarer who already battled you today: one more rematch. Used up.

name: Warden Weakener
description: Offered before a Rift Warden battle you lost once before: the Warden's team starts with 15% less Vigor. One per battle, not in Rift-Born. Used up.

name: Rift Anchor
description: Offered after you lose to a Rift Warden: you stay right before it with a rested team instead of going back to the spring. Not in Rift-Born. Used up.

name: Temper Shift
description: Sets one Spirling's temperament to one you choose. Used up.

name: Power Core
description: Doubles the lean of one Spirling's temperament: +10% instead of +5% on its stat. Permanent. Used up.

name: Gleam Prism
description: Turns one Spirling you choose into its Gleam form for good: +10% on all values and a Riftglass sheen. Used up.

name: Spark Forge
description: Sets all Spark values of one Spirling to the top (12). Shows the new values first.

name: Rift Breath
description: In battle: brings a defeated Spirling back with half its Vigor. One per battle.

name: Great Rift Breath
description: In battle: brings a defeated Spirling back with full Vigor and full energy. One per battle.

name: Riftglass Tonic
description: In battle: heals all Vigor and every state. Two per battle.

name: Glass Spark
description: In battle: fills a Spirling's energy and gives 1 more at the end of each of the next 3 turns. Three per battle.

name: Overcharge Core
description: Use it before a battle: the whole team starts the next battle with 12 instead of 10 energy, maximum 12.

name: Overcharge Core Plus
description: Use it before an Open League battle: the whole team starts with 12 instead of 10 energy. Only works in the Open League.

name: Will to Win
description: Works by itself: if your whole team is defeated, the last one returns once with 30% Vigor. Not against Rift Wardens.

name: Rift Script: Glowglass Slash
description: Teaches Glowglass Slash (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, 20% chance to scorch) to one Ember Spirling. Used up.

name: Rift Script: Floodglass Wave
description: Teaches Floodglass Wave (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, 20% chance to soak) to one Tide Spirling. Used up.

name: Rift Script: Vineglass Sting
description: Teaches Vineglass Sting (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, heals 25% of the damage) to one Bloom Spirling. Used up.

name: Rift Script: Boltglass Bite
description: Teaches Boltglass Bite (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, 30% chance to lower Pace) to one Volt Spirling. Used up.

name: Rift Script: Rockglass Ram
description: Teaches Rockglass Ram (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, 30% chance to raise own Guard) to one Stone Spirling. Used up.

name: Rift Script: Stormglass Cut
description: Teaches Stormglass Cut (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, strikes first) to one Gale Spirling. Used up.

name: Rift Script: Lightglass Beam
description: Teaches Lightglass Beam (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, cures the user's own condition) to one Lumen Spirling. Used up.

name: Rift Script: Duskglass Grip
description: Teaches Duskglass Grip (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, 30% chance to lower Focus) to one Umbra Spirling. Used up.

name: Stat Crystal +1
description: Adds 1 to one chosen value of one Spirling, counted like Spark. Up to 24 per value, twice the Spark cap. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Stat Crystal +5
description: Adds 5 to one chosen value of one Spirling, counted like Spark. Up to 24 per value, twice the Spark cap. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Stat Crystal +10
description: Adds 10 to one chosen value of one Spirling, counted like Spark. Up to 24 per value, twice the Spark cap. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Mighty Growth Crystal
description: Five times the growth for the whole team for the next 20 battles.

name: Great Coin Gleam
description: Triple coins from battles for 20 battles.

name: Grand Ring Tonic
description: A Spirling gains 10 Rings at once. Never above the Ring cap.

name: Ring Crown
description: A Spirling jumps to Ring 50 at once. Never above the Ring cap.

name: Bond Lure I
description: Bonding gets 15% easier for one try. Tier 1 of 4. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Bond Lure II
description: Bonding gets 30% easier for one try. Tier 2 of 4. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Bond Lure III
description: Bonding gets 45% easier for one try. Tier 3 of 4. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Bond Lure IV
description: Bonding gets 60% easier for one try. Tier 4 of 4. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Lure Scent I
description: Uncommon, shy and ancient wild Spirlings step out twice as often for the next 100 steps. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Lure Scent II
description: Uncommon, shy and ancient wild Spirlings step out 3 times as often for the next 100 steps. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Lure Scent III
description: Uncommon, shy and ancient wild Spirlings step out 5 times as often for the next 100 steps. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Shimmer Scent
description: Wild Spirlings show their Gleam form 10 times as often for the next 100 steps. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Second Try Charm
description: Hold it out on a bond: if the bond fails, you try once more at once. Used up. Story only, not in leagues.

name: Unfurl Spark
description: A Spirling unfurls into its next form at once, without its Ring or other conditions. Not for forms that need an item. Used up.

name: Grand Tonic
description: In battle: heals all Vigor and every state. No limit per battle.
